description:
## [1.1.0](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-10-02)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ads:** Disabled Braze in-app message registration ([06077d1](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/06077d14007ccfcf34cb5a01bee0598844eba2a6))
* **aftership:** aligned map controls with tracking toolbar ([4e03d67](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/4e03d674715136664b8c2fe1bde9560dd99de96c))
* **aftership:** resolved checkpoint coordinates from geo entities ([caf5cb9](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/caf5cb9c6df2d2d9252916ebe6cd37e44aef0ca7))
* **blackjack:** aligned skip level dialog touch target with safe area insets ([cc2ecca](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/cc2ecca92ef89df7c563dead4b212a0ef3d3028a))
* **blackjack:** closed chip file stream via try-with-resources ([a0758bc](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/a0758bca3149c77e89d8bfe683e25619a30b36ea))
* **blackjack:** logged 16 kb page alignment configuration failure ([780cdda](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/780cdda9343709841d0727189b09b80a49f7eaf2))
* **blackjack:** recalibrated skip level dialog touch target ([e128e1b](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/e128e1b844f8793897cd552b73c8803ccc95b66a))
* **generator:** mapped patch dependencies by display name ([328db4b](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/328db4b8c104ead3b6cea75255e809018a1f6e3d))
* **sezzle:** corrected byte sequences for hidden AI elements ([26f16bd](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/26f16bd1d30ff1fb60a84fb77d3cf287bd7dd1ac))
* **sezzle:** corrected jail monkey rooted check class targeting ([d556f97](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/d556f97c0c577a1c15b61e37b38802c986ddf243))
* **sezzle:** preserved total cents fallback in header navigation ([e480112](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/e480112d9a4a13f7ab3efb977d70bea22ae94e78))
* **sidelineswap:** refined method matching for telemetry overrides ([987a098](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/987a098ac588f5c5c0ae8b39175e89007f91636b))
* **sidelineswap:** validated hex format for brand color options ([67a83d1](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/67a83d1fd9575deffe25ae177e7dd8b07183c8c4))

### ✨ New Features

* **patches/main:** Expanded Sezzle navigation controls ([b76447c](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/b76447cda548ca22fdf981efaec51c11dd3ff43a))
* **patches:** Added multi-application patch suites ([9ba0e11](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/9ba0e11f7f9c81a2a940534eeb0baefdb863d927))

patches.name: Add Copy Tracking Number Option
patches.description: Adds an option to copy tracking numbers in the multi-shipment selection menu.

patches.name: Bypass Native Signature Check
patches.description: Neutralizes APK signature verification in libandroidsig-lib.so so API requests succeed when signed with custom keys.

patches.name: Custom Google Maps API Key
patches.description: Replaces the embedded Google Maps API key with a personal Google Cloud API key so native Google Maps renders on re-signed builds. Note: To use native Google Maps, disable the OpenStreetMap Drop-in Replacement patch.

options.description: Custom Google Maps API key from Google Cloud Console (with Maps SDK for Android enabled).

patches.name: Full AMOLED Theme
patches.description: Themes AfterShip in pure AMOLED black by removing dark gray backgrounds from the bottom navigation bar, account items, cards, and windows.

patches.name: Hide Broken Tracking Map
patches.description: Suppresses the unauthenticated blank white Google Maps view when neither a custom Google Maps API key nor OpenStreetMap is used.

patches.name: OpenStreetMap Drop-in Replacement
patches.description: Replaces the broken Google Maps view with a free, self-contained OpenStreetMap (Leaflet) engine that renders routes, checkpoints, and dark/light styled tiles without requiring an API key.

options.description: Displays floating + and − zoom buttons on the map.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Neutralizes in-app advertisements (Disco Network SDK shopping/cashback ads and list placements), removes the 'Leave us a 5-star review' in-app rating prompt dialogs, zeros the Google Play Advertising ID (AAID), disables first-party behavioral and impression analytics (StatisticsCenter, AbsListImpEventHelper, AutoUploadManager), and blocks diagnostic telemetry (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Logan logging).

patches.name: Remove AfterShip Account Page Links
patches.description: Removes the About the app, Share the app, and Feedback links from the Account screen.

patches.name: Remove Feedback
patches.description: Removes prompting for feedback on shipments.

patches.name: Remove Login
patches.description: Forces guest mode always on first install, removes login buttons and carousels, strips account/login controls from the Account tab, and suppresses login prompts.

patches.name: Remove Shipment Sync
patches.description: Removes email shipment synchronization features, including prompts, banners, dialogs, empty state sync cards, and account settings.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Telemetry
patches.description: Neutralizes Gainsight PX behavioral analytics (session tracking, screen views, custom events, user identification) and disables the Cordova Gainsight native plugin.

patches.name: Remove Web Telemetry
patches.description: Removes Sentry error/performance reporting, CSP telemetry endpoints, and Gainsight web bootstrap scripts from the embedded Cordova web bundle.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Analytics
patches.description: Neutralizes behavioral tracking (Pendo SDK session recordings, guides, and click tracking), student surveillance telemetry (Pandata pageview recording, time-spent counters, and background upload worker), first-party app analytics (ScreenView processors, offline analytics, token logging), crash reporting (Firebase Crashlytics), and in-app rating prompts.

patches.name: Clean Authentication
patches.description: Shows Google sign-in only and removes the unavailable phone sign-in controls.

options.description: Adds a patched-app caution warning below the Google sign-in message on the login screen.

patches.name: Configure Shortcuts
patches.description: Customizes items displayed in the Your Shortcuts carousel.

options.description: Hides the Refer a Friend shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Giveaway shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Offers shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Rewards shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Sezzle Mobile shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.

patches.name: Enable App Debugging
patches.description: Marks the app debuggable so patch developers can use ADB run-as after reinstalling.

patches.name: Hide Sezzle Mobile
patches.description: Hides Sezzle Mobile offers and account entry points.

patches.name: Patch Consent Screen
patches.description: Requires consent to a patched-app warning before opening Sezzle authentication.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Removes all ads (AppLovin MAX, Google Mobile Ads, Rokt, Playtime, InBrain Surveys) and disables analytics and tracking SDKs (AppsFlyer, FullStory, Braze, Firebase Analytics, mParticle, Facebook SDK, AppCenter).

patches.name: Remove Promos & Giveaways
patches.description: Blocks in-app deal popups, giveaway screens, Knot card-linking dialogs, and marketing banners across the app.

options.description: Suppresses in-session merchant deal popovers, store offer modals, and webview deal overlays.
Suppresses Knot card auto-sync onboarding dialogs, activation gates, and account linking banners.
Removes promotional merchant cards, empty state marketing, and boost banners from wallet screens.
Neutralizes Playtime campaign listings and rewards promo carousels in Hermes UI.
Hides referral invite banners ("Give and Get"), contact permission prompts, and social share modals.
Hides live trivia giveaway banners and push-to-start game prompts.
Suppresses the pre-permission "Don't Miss Out!" marketing dialog (NotificationPermissionModalV2 / EnableNotificationsModal) and bypasses soft push-opt-in gates.

patches.name: Remove Rewards
patches.description: Removes Rewards navigation while keeping Account's Sezzle Points item and routing the Home shortcut to the same page.

patches.name: Replace AI Discover with Products
patches.description: Replaces the AI Discover navigation tab with Sezzle's original non-AI Products tab and removes the Sezzle AI callout in search. Includes an option to remove the Products tab completely.

options.description: Removes the Products tab from the navigation bar altogether instead of keeping it as a replacement for Discover.

patches.name: Replace Shop with Home
patches.description: Replaces the Shop bottom navigation tab with Home, a custom screen to replace the overly-commercial Shop screen.

patches.name: Suppress In-App Updates and Rating Prompts
patches.description: Neutralizes Hermes Redux update sagas, UpdateAppModal dialogs, Play Store URL redirects, trustFall tamper detection, and in-app rating prompts.

options.description: Neutralizes Redux force update sagas, version verification selectors, and UpdateAppModal.
Forces trustFall, isJailBroken, hookDetected, and canMockLocation to always return false in Hermes JS.
Suppresses in-app review requests and milestone rating dialogs that redirect to Google Play.

patches.name: Suppress Updates and Integrity Checks
patches.description: Disables Microsoft CodePush OTA updates and neutralizes Dalvik root and tamper detection SDKs (RootBeer and JailMonkey).

options.description: Prevents Microsoft CodePush from downloading remote JavaScript bundles that override local patches.
Bypasses RootBeer and JailMonkey checks in Dalvik bytecode so modified or rooted devices are never flagged.

patches.name: Unlock Custom App Icons
patches.description: Enables custom launcher app icons (Arctic, Peach, Glass, Rainbow, Sand, Classic) without requiring a Sezzle Premium subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Developer Settings
patches.description: Makes the internal Development Settings menu visible to every signed-in account.

patches.name: Unlock Receipt Scanner
patches.description: Makes the receipt scanner available from Development Settings and forces its V2 flow to render. REQUIRES Unlock Developer Settings to be enabled.

patches.name: Block Tracking and Telemetry
patches.description: Neutralizes first-party analytics (SidelineSwap backend), behavioral tracking (Amplitude, Firebase Analytics, Facebook App Events, Iterable), diagnostic telemetry (Firebase Crashlytics, Timber logging tree), payment gateway telemetry (Braintree FPTI), and zeros the Google Play Advertising ID (AAID).

patches.name: Change Brand Color
patches.description: Customizes the primary accent brand color across SidelineSwap buttons, navigation highlights, badges, and accents.

options.description: Hex color string (e.g. #1E88E5 for Material Blue, #9C27B0 for Purple, #FF5722 for Orange, #000000 for Monochrome).
Hex color string for status bars and dark accents (defaults to #1565C0).

patches.name: Add Custom Chip Store
patches.description: Replaces the unavailable store with a dialog to view and set your exact chip balance.

patches.name: Custom Chip Store Binary Hook
patches.description: Hooks BlackjackApplication.OpenShop and CheckUpdateToVersion in libil2cpp.so to bridge the custom chip store.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes banner, interstitial, and rewarded advertising and removes ad-based chip offers.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Analytics
patches.description: Neutralizes active advertising telemetry, analytics, attribution, and crash reporting.

patches.name: Skip to Next Level
patches.description: Allows tapping the next level indicator on the top bar to show a confirmation dialog and skip to the next level. REQUIRES Add Custom Chip Store to be enabled.
